trends.name: Iran-US Strait of Hormuz Crisis
trends.summary: Trump issued 48-hour ultimatum to Iran to open Strait of Hormuz or face obliteration of power plants. Iran responded by threatening complete closure and attacks on vital Middle East infrastructure. This represents an immediate geopolitical risk that could disrupt 20%+ of global oil supply and trigger sharp energy/inflation repricing across markets.

trends.name: Bitcoin Tumbles on War Fears
trends.summary: Bitcoin slumped below $69,000 (lowest since early March), down ~20% since conflict escalation began, as rising US-Israel-Iran tensions shake crypto markets. Undermines narrative of crypto as safe-haven asset during geopolitical crises.

trends.name: Oil Market Shock & Tariff Inflation
trends.summary: Hormuz crisis intersects with tariff-driven inflation. Libya halting El Feel output to redirect flows, and Iran threatening supply cuts create multi-layered oil shock. Combined with Trump tariffs, this will drive up prices for commodities, plastics, chocolate, berries, and menstrual products across consumer markets.

trends.name: Tech Valuation Stretched Near Historical Highs
trends.summary: S&P 500 expanded tech forward P/E ratio now near long-term median since 1995, signaling valuations are stretched. Combined with correction warnings and concerns about Nvidia alternatives being built by customers, tech sector faces pressure despite long-term AI optimism.

trends.name: S&P 500 Correction Risks Emerging
trends.summary: Markets teetering on edge of correction territory as technicals align bearishly. 'TACO trade' (TAX cuts, AI, Crypto, Oil) showing signs of flop. 'Next bear market may have just begun' warnings from analysts suggest 10%+ downside risk.

trends.name: Central Banks Spook Markets
trends.summary: Global central bank actions and rate policies continue to dominate sentiment. Oil and rates cited as primary drivers of market direction. Uncertainty around Fed policy amid inflation/geopolitical shocks creating volatility.

trends.name: ICE Enforcement & Immigration Policy Impacts
trends.summary: ICE agents deployed to US airports Monday signaling aggressive immigration enforcement. This could impact labor market dynamics, wage inflation, and consumer pricing across sectors dependent on immigrant workers (agriculture, hospitality, construction).

trends.name: International Stocks Underperform Amid War
trends.summary: 2026 was supposed to be the year for international equity recovery, but Iran war has undermined those dynamics. US markets regaining dominance as safe haven, pressuring emerging markets and non-US developed equities.

trends.name: AI Capex Concerns & OpenAI Data Center Pivot
trends.summary: OpenAI's shift toward data center infrastructure amid IPO pipeline raises Wall Street spending concerns. Questions about whether AI capex boom will sustain and deliver ROI. Combined with Nvidia customer alternatives, AI narrative faces credibility test.

trends.name: Preferred Stocks & High-Yield Income Plays
trends.summary: Investors rotating into preferred stocks and discounted high-yield securities (7-12% yields trading below NAV) as rate environment stabilizes. Preferred stock machine and BDC strategies gaining traction amid volatility.

trends.name: EV Competition Intensifies with BYD Tech Leap
trends.summary: BYD unveiled rapid-charge EV (10-70% in 5 minutes, full charge in 9) proving Chinese EV dominance accelerating. Raises questions about Tesla's competitive moat and US EV strategy as international players accelerate innovation.

trends.name: Healthcare Sector Resilience Despite Macro Wobble
trends.summary: Aging population continues to drive healthcare hiring and demand even if broader economy weakens. Healthcare emerges as defensive sector hedge against macro deterioration and geopolitical shocks.
